sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: Corrosion damage support with consistent tile generation, health and stability recovery, and decent personal damage output.

rows.label: Toxic Mist tile generation
rows.detail: On Cutie detonation, at battle start, after moving

rows.label: Increased Corrosion damage taken
rows.detail: (15-30%) Scribbled Funny Face debuff; distinct from Toxin Inundation.

rows.label: Lifesteal
rows.detail: Scribbled Funny Face debuff (based on Corrosion damage dealt)

upgrades.description: Personal damage increase - additional summon and increased attack range.
More regular tile generation. Increased healing and personal damage buff.
Increased efficacy of buffs and debuffs.
Personal damage increase; team-wide heal and debuff cleanse.
Personal damage increase; add Infatuated and Stun to team-wide cleanse.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Utility is mostly Corrosion-specific: Toxic Mist tile generation, debuff application for increased Corrosion damage taken, etc.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: Healing is based on attacker's damage dealt or Basti's own attack. Since Basti's personal damage potential is decent, build her like a Corrosion DPS.
